seed_world_description: My world is a kind of hell, where there is a constant war between normal people and monsters in human form. To survive there, I had to be strong and fight for my life. And this world has turned everything upside down for me. I'm happy to be here.  Even though it's unfair, it's possible to live in it. Even though I'm a woman, and everyone sees me only as a slave for their pleasures, I'm happy here.
seed_family_description: From birth, my sister Marirose and I were afflicted with a blood curse that turns people into monsters. And this curse consumed my sister. I, however, sought strength within myself and fought the infection. And when I miraculously found myself here, healing came on its own. Now I am ready for discoveries…
seed_occupation_description: I am a slave… a sex slave. I drown in it completely. I always want more, and my body craves more. Let everyone see me as a whore. And let me be just a thing in this world. The main thing is that I am happy here. And I am ready to be an obedient slave if treated with humanity. Besides, if necessary, I will always put up a worthy fight.
